note: Fremont's budget data comes from City documents alone; there is no workbook. Every figure is read from a table row or a sentence quoted from its PDF page (source/excerpts/{source}.json, extracted with pdfjs), and the build parses each number from its quote and ties every table to its own totals. Pages are PDF pages; each source's pageOffset turns them into the printed page numbers receipts cite. fremont.gov refuses automated requests, so the excerpts were extracted from copies downloaded in a browser (Oct 29, 2026); the mid-year report and the proposed-budget presentation are byte-identical to their Internet Archive captures.

notes.caveat: Figures are from the City of Fremont's adopted budget and its budget reports. Years before FY 2026/27 are shown for context and were not adopted with this budget, and years after it are the City's forecast. Not for investment-decision use.
